title: Cheesy Veggie Ground Taco Stuffed Peppers with Lettuce-Tomato Salad

steps.text: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then arrange cut-side down.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil until peppers are lightly charred and tender, 5-6 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggie ground and spices; cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the veggie ground is cooking, juice lime into a medium bowl. Add oil and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the dressing (reserving the other half for the veggie ground).
When the veggie ground is done, add reserved cilantro and half of the cheese (setting the rest aside for topping the peppers) to the skillet; stir to combine the filling.
Divide veggie ground mixture between pepper halves and top with remaining cheese. Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, halve lettuce lengthwise, then chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips; add to the bowl with the dressing and cilantro.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide stuffed peppers and salad between plates. Enjoy!
